Our Story

A print studio in the hills that started serving really good coffee.

The Blue Art Cafe began in a disused lithography workshop above the Ganga, where the previous tenants left behind a wall stained permanently ultramarine from decades of ink. Rather than paint over it, we built the whole cafe around it — the color became the name, and the name became the standard we hold our coffee to.

Up here the mornings arrive slow and cold off the river, mist sitting low over the hills until the sun clears the ridge — which is most of why the espresso is dialled in so carefully; a good cup matters more when the walk up from Ram Jhula has left you half-frozen. Every bag we pull is roasted by small producers we visit ourselves; every wall is loaned, sold, or repainted by an artist working in the room next to you.

— Priya Raman, Founder & Head Roaster

The Menu

Pulled, poured, plated.

Beans rotate seasonally — ask your barista what's on pour-over today. All milk drinks available with oat, almond, or whole.
